hints.title: Even Bit Position Filtering
hints.text: A power of four must first be a power of two, but powers of two also include numbers where the single set bit resides at odd bit positions.

hints.title: Hexadecimal Mask Invariant
hints.text: In powers of four, the solitary bit always sits at an even index like zero, two, or four. Masking against hexadecimal 0x55555555 isolates even bit positions.

hints.title: Two Stage Bitwise Conjunction Procedure
hints.text: Verify that n is strictly positive and that n bitwise conjoined with n minus one equals zero. Then confirm that n bitwise conjoined with 0x55555555 is non-zero, proving the set bit is in an even bit position.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping division takes O(log4 N) operations and floating point log base 4 checks risk precision rounding errors on large integers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Combining power of two check n & (n - 1) == 0 with bitmask 0x55555555 provides an exact O(1) time and O(1) space validation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize why 0x55555555 (binary 010101...01) precisely isolates the even powers of two.
